proof_commands.name: postgis_proof
proof_commands.command: bash -lc bash scripts/proof_postgis.sh && cp artifacts/proof/postgis_proof.log artifacts/proof/current/postgis_proof.log

proof_commands.name: check_node_policy
proof_commands.command: bash -lc NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 20 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'BLOCKED_NODE_VERSION: nvm use 20 failed -- install Node 20 via: nvm install 20'; exit 1; }; "[REDACTED_LOCAL_PATH]/backend/.venv/bin/python" scripts/check_node_policy.py --root "[REDACTED_LOCAL_PATH]"
